title: Storage engines and relation boundaries
summary: The engine has distinct FILE, OBJECT/SNAPSHOT, explicit JSON projection, native SQLite/GeoPackage and federated relation providers. JSON is never implicitly flattened; SQLite native reading sits below SQL and does not introduce a second SQL evaluator.
invariants: JSON crosses into relations only through explicit row/column projections.
Native SQLite is page-oriented and read-only at this baseline.
GeoPackage adds typed geometry over native SQLite transport.
Provider semantics remain outside NoSQLServer; SQL scanning a relation does not make the relation's producer policy truth.
